back: A weather event that can cause loss of life, injury, damage to property or disruption to economic activity.
A long period with rainfall well below normal, so water, crops and pasture suffer.
Late onset or early end of rains, mid-season dry spells, El Niño years, persistent high pressure.
1991-92 and 2015-16 were El Niño years with severe drought in southern Africa.
Heavy or prolonged rain, saturated or bare ground, flat low-lying land beside rivers, deforestation in catchments.
Low-lying Muzarabani (Zambezi valley) and Tsholotsho (Matabeleland North).
Shelter in a solid building or closed car; avoid isolated trees, hilltops, water and fences; fit lightning conductors.
Cold, dense air drains downhill on clear, calm nights and collects in valley bottoms, where frost is worst.
A town warmer than the surrounding countryside because buildings store heat and traffic and industry release it.
Towns (heat island), deforestation (drier), dams (more humid, milder), industry (smog, acid rain), cloud seeding.
